notes: All PNG layers use the exact 894x839 source canvas.
Visible head artwork is directly extracted from the original source without resizing or repositioning.
The headband and ears are part of the head because they should move rigidly with it.
The quiver and arrows remain in the body layer because they are rigidly attached to the torso and do not need independent spring motion for this minimal portrait rig.
A narrow hidden band behind the head was reconstructed only to support subtle head translation and rotation.
eyes_closed.png is a full-canvas blink overlay containing only the small eye regions.
hair_back, hair_left, hair_right, ponytail and beard were skipped because they do not apply to this character.
Normalized pivot coordinates use x=0 left, x=1 right, y=0 bottom, y=1 top.
